VVS Oncology
VVS Oncology Service
The VVS oncology team are on hand to assist you with the following types of cases:
Lymphoid cancers
Skin cancers
Metastasis
Blood cancers
Chemotherapy advice
Mast cell staging and treatment
Osteosarcoma/bone cancers
Soft tissue sarcomas
Palliative care
Surgical cancer recommendations
By working with our team of experienced oncologists you can deliver world-class care to your patients from the comfort of your own practice. In addition to advising on individual oncology cases, our specialists can help you to establish a safe and viable chemotherapy service within your current practice. Maintain close bonds with your patients and their owners by offering specialist chemotherapy care without them needing to travel to distant referral centres. Empower and upskill you and your team, whilst earning CPD with our bespoke oncology packages.
Our oncology service is designed to assist in the delivery of exceptional patient-centred oncological care in general practice. Using the VVS workstation you can enjoy the reassurance of live-guided specialist support and advice during chemotherapy preparation and administration.
If you don’t yet have the VVS workstation, then we are still on hand to assist via advice calls and case reports.
Refer a Case
Our specialists will help you to work up these challenging cases, reach a diagnosis and establish a treatment plan that is right for your patients and your clients.
Some of the services the VVS oncology team offer:
Specialist and owner teleconsultation
Specialist case advice call
Specialist oncology written case review
For a complete list of services and prices please get in touch at
[email protected]
